spine.active_goal: Bring the prototype's Meadow (renamed from Garden) into the live Flutter app: per-user, per-year randomized meadow generation, the year / day-by-day / year-so-far UI, viewing past years, and hover or select on a flower showing its planted date, while keeping the current aesthetic and making it smooth with up to 366 flowers on macOS and Android. Spec it with the interphase prototype pathway, get approval, then dispatch with mitosis.
spine.next_step: Get the owner's answers to two questions, then wait for their merges. First question: should the Meadow keep animating on macOS while the window is visible but unfocused? It currently pauses whenever the app is not resumed; a change would go on the Scene branch, #242. Second question: should the goldens CI job set TZ=America/Edmonton and trigger on lib/features/garden/** and test/features/garden/goldens/**? The Meadow page goldens skip outside UTC-6. After #241, #242 and #243 merge in that order, run criterion c3's live pass. Use integration_test/meadow_perf_bench_test.dart as a separately-identified .plain profile APK installed with adb on the Note10+, and never flutter drive. Separately, on macOS run it in the Parallels guest reverted to its clean snapshot. Read the 12 cases against 16.22 (60 fps, 366 flowers) and 16.12 (open within 1 s, no frame over 100 ms).
spine.last_session: 2026-09-30: mitosis finished; PRs #241/#242/#243 open as stacked drafts, all gates pass. Removal Lane finished by hand (garden_view.dart out of write-set) and shell keyboard focus guard made scroll-aware; full suite 3886 passed on Page. Open owner questions: Meadow pauses on macOS whenever the window loses focus (spec says pause when not resumed); Meadow goldens skip outside UTC-6 and the goldens CI job neither runs on garden paths nor sets TZ.
